note: Independent rejudge against RFC 2866 Section 4.1 ("If the Accounting-Request packet includes a Framed-IP-Address, that attribute MUST contain the IP address of the user. If the Access-Accept used the special values for Framed-IP-Address telling the NAS to assign or negotiate an IP address for the user, the Framed-IP-Address (if any) in the Accounting-Request MUST contain the actual IP address assigned or negotiated."). In f51b0d1ae0, TestRFC2866AccountingReportsTheAddressTheNASAssigned and TestRFC2866SpecialFramedIPValueIsNeverTheSubscriberAddress gained only the unused "" subscriber argument to extractAuthMetadata; inputs and assertions are unchanged. Both 0xFFFFFFFE (cleared by framedIPNASSelects) and 0xFFFFFFFF (refused by isValidSubscriberIP) leave FramedIP unset while preserving Framed-Pool/Session-Timeout, and buildAcctPacket reports the assigned IPv4 on Start/Interim/Stop. Clause 1 remains proven by TestAcctFramedIPAddressPresent, TestAcctFramedIPAddressIsSubscriberNotNAS, TestAcctFramedIPAddressOmittedWhenNotIPv4, TestSessionEventDrivesAddressAndPortID, TestAccountingAddressFamiliesShareLifetime, and test/l2tp/radius-acct-wire.ci. Verdict enforced stands.
